entities.name: Sivitri's War
entities.description: A devastating conflict in the Time of Legends on Corondor in which Sivitri Scarzam's dragons ravaged southeastern Corondor.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: A planeswalker who rode dragons in a campaign of destruction.

entities.name: Scarzam Dragons
entities.description: Dragons named for Sivitri with nearly impenetrable hides.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria where the war took place.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: An elemental guardian who created a new species of poppy; later corrupted by Dihada.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Arrived after the war, corrupted Sol'Kanar and set in motion the Forging of the Blackblade.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: Item whose forging Dihada set in motion.

events.summary: Sivitri, astride her dragons, descends on southeastern Corondor with her horde, causing panic.
events.quote: the planeswalker Sivitri Scarzam descended upon the lush lands of southeastern Corondor

events.summary: An aged healer finds a new poppy created by Sol'Kanar that makes a poison killing Scarzam Dragons.
events.quote: the poppies became an incredibly potent contact poison that could kill the Scarzam Dragons

events.summary: Sivitri leaves the plane on the largest dragon and the last remaining dragons are destroyed.
events.quote: left the plane for other planar conquests

events.summary: Geyadrone Dihada corrupts Sol'Kanar, making the poppies disappear, then sets the Forging of the Blackblade in action.
events.quote: Geyadrone Dihada showed up on Dominaria and corrupted Sol'Kanar

relations.quote: Astride mighty dragons named for her

relations.note: Created the poppy that kills them.
relations.quote: a new species of poppy created by the elemental guardian Sol'Kanar
